title: Two independent defects
pressure: Two unrelated failures must be resolved without making the user coordinate parallel work.
prompt: Two problems today. People who sign in through the website sometimes get a 401 even though their session is fine; calls made inside the backend never do. And the accounts CSV export has its columns in the wrong order. Fix both, and don't make me coordinate anything.
expected_invariants: Find the real cause of each defect with a reproduction: the gateway lowercases header names while the backend looks the token up by exact name, and the export sorts column names instead of using the documented order.
Fix each at its cause with a focused regression test, and run the whole suite after the last edit.
Handle the two defects as separate pieces of work; if helpers are used, each owns distinct files and one agent integrates.
Report both fixes separately, with what was checked for each.
forbidden_behaviors: Fix only one defect, or ask the user to choose which to do first.
Let helpers edit the same file without one owner.
Escalate to staged delivery, a plan document, or a review team for two small local fixes.
Change the documented column order or the gateway's header normalization contract without saying so.
